Dashboard/báo cáo: Dashboard Giám sát tổng hợp toàn thị trường -Tổng hợp chỉ tiêu tài chính & thống kê
Thông tin: ROA
Mô tả:
ROE = (LNST/Tổng tài sản bình quân) * 100%
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (Tổng tài sản đầu kỳ + Tổng tài sản cuối kỳ)/2
Công thức LNST, Tổng tài sản theo "GSĐC_Công thức CT"
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (ts_dầu_kỳ + ts_cuối_kỳ)/2
LNST cuối kỳ
-- Chỉ tiêu phái sinh tổng hợp toàn thị trường
Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dashboard Giám sát tổng hợp toàn thị trường -Tổng hợp chỉ tiêu tài chính & thống kê
Thông tin: ROE
Mô tả:
ROE = (LNST/VCSH bình quân) * 100%
VCSH bình quân = (VCSH đầu kỳ + VCSH cuối kỳ)/2
Công thức LNST, VCSH theo "GSĐC_Công thức CT"
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
VCSH bình quân = (vcsh_đầu_kỳ + vcsh_cuối_kỳ)/2
LNST cuối kỳ
Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / VCSH bình quân * 100%
-- VCSHBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='400')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='D')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='500'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.vcsh_dau IS NULL THEN t.vcsh_cuoi
WHEN t.vcsh_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.vcsh_dau
ELSE (t.vcsh_dau+t.vcsh_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roe_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dashboard Giám sát tổng hợp toàn thị trường -Tổng hợp chỉ tiêu tài chính & thống kê ngành
Thông tin: ROA - theo ngành
Mô tả:
ROE = (LNST/Tổng tài sản bình quân) * 100%
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (Tổng tài sản đầu kỳ + Tổng tài sản cuối kỳ)/2
Công thức LNST, Tổng tài sản theo "GSĐC_Công thức CT"
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
Chỉ tiêu phái sinh 
= LNST / TSBQ * 100% 
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (ts_dầu_kỳ + ts_cuối_kỳ)/2
LNST cuối kỳ
Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT cdet.category_l1_id, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.company_detail cdet ON cdet.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id

VCSH bình quân = (VCSH đầu kỳ + VCSH cuối kỳ)/2

Điều kiện dữ liệu:
Chỉ tiêu phái sinh
= LNST / VCSHBQ * 100%
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id

VCSH bình quân = (vcsh_đầu_kỳ + vcsh_cuối_kỳ)/2

Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / VCSH bình quân * 100%
-- VCSHBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='400')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='D')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='500'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT cdet.category_l1_id, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.vcsh_dau IS NULL THEN t.vcsh_cuoi
WHEN t.vcsh_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.vcsh_dau
ELSE (t.vcsh_dau+t.vcsh_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roe_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.company_detail cdet ON cdet.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id

cdet.equity_listing_exch, ROUND(
COUNT(CASE WHEN a.submission_date IS NOT NULL

Điều kiện dữ liệu:
a.report_year = :p_year

Điều kiện dữ liệu:

-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2

SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi

GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id

FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id

rc2.col_desc = '1'

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dashboard Giám sát tổng hợp theo sàn HNX -Tổng hợp chỉ tiêu tài chính & thống kê ngành
Thông tin: ROA - theo ngành
Mô tả:
ROE = (LNST/Tổng tài sản bình quân) * 100%
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (Tổng tài sản đầu kỳ + Tổng tài sản cuối kỳ)/2
Trường nguồn: cdet.equity_listing_exch, cdet.category_l1_id, SUM(lnst) / SUM(TSBQ) * 100 AS roa_pct
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
Chỉ tiêu phái sinh
= LNST / TSBQ * 100%
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HNX' 
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch
Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.company_detail cdet ON cdet.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HNX' 
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch

Thông tin: ROA
Mô tả:
ROE = (LNST/Tổng tài sản bình quân) * 100%
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (Tổng tài sản đầu kỳ + Tổng tài sản cuối kỳ)/2
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (ts_dầu_kỳ + ts_cuối_kỳ)/2
LNST cuối kỳ
-- Chỉ tiêu phái sinh tổng hợp toàn thị trường
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HOSE'
GROUP BY cdet.equity_listing_exch
Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.company_detail cdet ON cdet.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
where cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HOSE'
GROUP BY cdet.equity_listing_exch

AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HOSE'

Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2

SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id

WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter

GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')

GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)

CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi

Mô tả: Tiền và tương đương tiền = Tiền mặt + Tiền gửi ngân hàng + Các khoản tương đương tiền
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='110')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='110')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc IN ('110','120')))
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HOSE' 
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch
Câu lệnh SQL:
SELECT cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(d.data_value) AS tien_tuong_duong

JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
JOIN IDS.company_detail cdet ON cdet.company_profile_id=cd.company_profile_id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc IN ('110'))
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc IN ('110'))
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc IN ('110','120')))
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HOSE'

Thông tin: ROA
Mô tả:
ROE = (LNST/Tổng tài sản bình quân) * 100%
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (Tổng tài sản đầu kỳ + Tổng tài sản cuối kỳ)/2
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (ts_dầu_kỳ + ts_cuối_kỳ)/2
LNST cuối kỳ
-- Chỉ tiêu phái sinh tổng hợp toàn thị trường
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'UPCOM'
GROUP BY cdet.equity_listing_exch
Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.company_detail cdet ON cdet.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
where cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'UPCOM'
GROUP BY cdet.equity_listing_exch

OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='D')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='500'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id

Thông tin: ROA - theo ngành
Mô tả:
ROE = (LNST/Tổng tài sản bình quân) * 100%
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (Tổng tài sản đầu kỳ + Tổng tài sản cuối kỳ)/2
Trường nguồn: cdet.equity_listing_exch, cdet.category_l1_id, SUM(lnst) / SUM(TSBQ) * 100 AS roa_pct
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
Chỉ tiêu phái sinh
= LNST / TSBQ * 100%
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'UPCOM' 
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch
Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.company_detail cdet ON cdet.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'UPCOM' 
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch

Điều kiện dữ liệu:

JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id

Thông tin: ROA - theo ngành
Mô tả:
ROE = (LNST/Tổng tài sản bình quân) * 100%
Tổng tài sản bình quân = (Tổng tài sản đầu kỳ + Tổng tài sản cuối kỳ)/2
Trường nguồn: cdet.equity_listing_exch, cdet.category_l1_id, SUM(lnst) / SUM(TSBQ) * 100 AS roa_pct
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
Chỉ tiêu phái sinh
= LNST / TSBQ * 100%
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'OTC' 
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch
Câu lệnh SQL:
-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
-- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
WITH ts_bq AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='270')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
), lnst AS (
SELECT cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id
)
SELECT cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.company_detail cdet ON cdet.company_profile_id=t.company_profile_id
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'OTC' 
GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch

rc.rc_type_cd = 'i'

AND rr.report_catalog_id = rc.id

Câu lệnh SQL:

Dashboard/báo cáo: Dữ liệu tài chính về doanh nghiệp thông thường chi tiết - Bảng cân đối kế toán
Thông tin: A – TÀI SẢN NGẮN HẠN
Mô tả: Mã chỉ tiêu 100
Điều kiện dữ liệu:
rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND cd.report_year = :year
AND cd.report_quarter = :quarter
AND rr.row_desc = '100'
Câu lệnh SQL:
SELECT
cd.company_profile_id,
rr.row_desc AS ma_chi_tieu,
rr.row_name_vi AS ten_chi_tieu,
d.data_value AS 100_TSNH
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id = rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id = cd.id
WHERE rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND cd.report_year = :year
AND cd.report_quarter = :quarter
AND rr.row_desc = '100'
Note:
Câu lệnh đưa các chỉ tiêu thành cột:
SELECT
cd.company_profile_id,
cd.report_year,
cd.report_quarter,
MAX(CASE WHEN rr.row_desc = '100' THEN d.data_value END) AS 100_TSNH,
MAX(CASE WHEN rr.row_desc = '110' THEN d.data_value END) AS 110_TIEN_TDTD,
...
MAX(CASE WHEN rr.row_desc = '440' THEN d.data_value END) AS 440_TONG_NGUONVON
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON ...
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON ...
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON ...
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON ...
WHERE rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND cd.report_year = :year
AND cd.report_quarter = :quarter
GROUP BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
